verse.verse_2: then raise sparks of fire (by their hoofs),
verse.verse_4: and blaze a trail of dust,
verse.verse_5: and penetrate deep into a host.
verse.verse_6: Verily man is most ungrateful to his Lord;
verse.verse_7: and he himself is a witness to that,
verse.verse_8: and surely he loves riches with a passionate loving.
verse.verse_9: Is he not aware that when whatever lies (buried) in the graves is overthrown;
verse.verse_10: and the secrets of the hearts are laid bare (and examined)?
verse.verse_11: Surely on that Day will their Lord be fully informed about them.
